40018881.author: पदार्थः
40018881.content: समरे in war, तथा thus, युध्यमनौ fighting, रामरावणौ Rama and Ravana, सर्वभूतानि all beings, विस्मितेन with astonishment, अन्तरात्मना in mind, ददृशुः observed

40018881.author: Translation
40018881.content: As Rama and Ravana were thus fighting in war, all beings watched with astonishment in mind.

40018882.author: पदार्थः
40018882.content: तयोः both, स्यन्दनोत्तमौ both moving quickly, परस्परम् one another, अर्धयन्तौ seeking to gain, अभिक्रुद्धौ very furious, परस्परम् one another, अभिद्रुतौ persevering

40018882.author: Translation
40018882.content: Both of them were moving quickly seeking to gain one another, very furiously persevering.

40018883.author: पदार्थः
40018883.content: परस्परवधे striking one another, युक्तौ diligently, मण्डलानि in circles, वीधीश्च feats, गतप्रत्यागतानि forwarding and receding, सूतसामर्थ्यजाम् displaying charioteers skills, बभूवतुः went on

40018883.author: Translation
40018883.content: Both striking one another diligently, going in circles moving forward and backward displaying feats, went on.

40018884.author: पदार्थः
40018884.content: रावणम् Ravana, अर्धयन् hurting, रामः Rama, राघवम् Raghava, रावणःचापि hurting Ravana, प्रतिवेगप्रवर्तने quickness in retaliation, गतिवेगम् speed of arrows, समापन्नौ happened

40018884.author: Translation
40018884.content: Ravana hurting Rama and vice versa displaying quickness in retaliation and speed of arrows, the fight happened.

40018885.author: पदार्थः
40018885.content: शरजालानि network of arrows, क्षिपतोः released, तयोः by both, स्यन्दनोत्तमौ excellent warriors, सासारौ in the battlefield, जलदौइव like water streams, संयुगमहीम् like two clouds, चेरतुः both chariots

40018885.author: Translation
40018885.content: The network of arrows released by both of them from the chariots were like water streams from two clouds in the battlefield

40018886.author: पदार्थः
40018886.content: तदा then, तौ those two, रणे in battlefield, बहुविधाम् many ways, गतिम् movements, दर्शयित्वा having seen, पुनरेव once again, परस्परस्य one another, अभिमुखौ facing each other, तस्थतुः stood

40018886.author: Translation
40018886.content: Then those two, having seen many movements, once again stood facing each other in the battlefield.

40018887.author: पदार्थः
40018887.content: तदा then, स्थितयोः standing, रथयोः chariots, धुरम् axle, धुरेण with axle, वाजिनाम् horses, वक्त्रम् standard, वक्त्रेण with face, पताकाः flags, पताकाभिः च with flag, समीयुः stood together

40018887.author: Translation
40018887.content: The two chariots stood facing each other on the battlefield once more, the axle of one chariot facing the axle of another chariot, the flag of one with another flag, the standard with another standard, the face of one horse with the face of another horse stood and it seemed as though they were together.

40018888.author: पदार्थः
40018888.content: ततः there upon, रामः Rama, धनुर्मुस्तै: stretching the bow, चतुर्भिःfour, शितैःsharp, शरैः arrows, रावणस्य at Ravana, दीप्तान् glowing, चतुरः four, हयान् horses, प्रत्यसर्पयत् drove back

40018888.author: Translation
40018888.content: Thereupon, Rama, stretching the bow, released four sharp glowing arrows at Ravana's four horses and drove them back.

40018889.author: पदार्थः
40018889.content: हयानाम् the horses, अपसर्पणे retreating, क्रोधवशम् prey to anger, आपन्नःafflicted, दशाननःtenheaded one, राघवाय on Raghava, निशितान् pointed, बाणान् arrows, मुमोच released

40018889.author: Translation
40018889.content: Fallen prey to anger for retreating the horses, the ten headed Ravana released pointed arrows on Raghava.

40018890.author: पदार्थः
40018890.content: बलवता mighty, दशग्रीवेण Ravana, अतिविद्धः wounded very much, राघवःRaghava, विकारम् agitated, न जगाम nor disquieted, व्यथितः च suffering, न अभवत् not experienced

40018890.author: Translation
40018890.content: Raghava, though wounded by the mighty Ravana's arrows, did notexperience suffering or agitation, nor disquiet.

40018891.author: पदार्थः
40018891.content: दशाननः Ten headed, वज्रहस्तस्य with thunderbolt like hands, सारथिम् charioteer, उद्दिश्य aimed, पुनःagain, वज्रपातसमस्वनान् equal to thunder, बाणान् arrow, चिक्षेप struck

40018891.author: Translation
40018891.content: The ten headed Ravana with his thunderbolt like hands hurled arrows and struck the charioteer of Rama, making sounds like thunder.

40018892.author: पदार्थः
40018892.content: मातलेःMatali, शरीरे body, पतिताः fallen, महावेगाः at great speed, शराः arrows, सुसूक्ष्ममपि even slight, सम्बोहम् perturbance, व्यथांवा or suffering, न प्रददुः not felt

40018892.author: Translation
40018892.content: Even though the arrows fell on Matali's body at great speed, he did not feel perturbed or experience even slight suffering.

40018893.author: पदार्थः
40018893.content: राघवः Raghava, मातलेः Matali, तयाधर्षणया like that torment, क्रुद्धः furious, आत्मनः himself, तथा in that way, न not, शरजालेन by the network of arrows, रिपुम् enemy, विमुखम् diverted, चकार made

40018893.author: Translation
40018893.content: Rama was furious for tormenting Matali like that, but not for hurting him and in fury discharged a network of arrows on him (Ravana) and diverted him.

40018894.author: पदार्थः
40018894.content: वीर hero, राघवःRaghava, रिपोः enemy, स्यन्दने chest, विंशतिम् twenty, त्रिंशतिम् thirty, षष्टिम् sixty, अथ and then, शतशः hundreds, सहस्रशः thousands, सायकान् shafts, मुमोच loosed at him

40018894.author: Translation
40018894.content: Heroic Raghava thereafter, let loose shafts in twenties, thirties, sixties, hundreds, and thousands at Ravana's chest.

40018895.author: पदार्थः
40018895.content: ततः then, क्रुद्धः enraged, राक्षसेश्वरः Rakshasa king, रावणोऽपि Ravana also, रणे in the battle, रामम् Rama, गदामुसलवर्षेण with mace and mallets, प्रत्यर्थयत् in return

40018895.author: Translation
40018895.content: Enraged Ravana, the king of Rakshasas, also in return, retaliated with maces and mallets.

40018896.author: पदार्थः
40018896.content: तत् then, प्रवृतं ensued, पुनः again, युद्धम् war, तुमुलम् tumultuous, रोमहर्षणम् caused hair to stand, गदानाम् with maces, मुसलानां च and mallets, परिघाणां च iron bars, निःस्वनैः by the resound of speed, सप्तसागराः the seven seas, क्षुभिताः agitated

40018896.author: Translation
40018896.content: Once again ensued a tumultuous war fought with maces, mallets, and iron bars, caused hair to stand and the resound of the speed of weapons caused agitation in the seven seas.

40018897.author: पदार्थः
40018897.content: तत् then, प्रवृतं ensued, पुनः again, युद्धम् war, तुमुलम् tumultuous, रोमहर्षणम् caused hair to stand, गदानाम् with maces, मुसलानां च and mallets, परिघाणां च iron bars, निःस्वनैः by the resound of speed, सप्तसागराः the seven seas, क्षुभिताः agitated

40018897.author: Translation
40018897.content: Once again ensued a tumultuous war fought with maces, mallets, and iron bars, caused hair to stand and the resound of the speed of weapons caused agitation in the seven seas.

40018898.author: पदार्थः
40018898.content: क्षुब्दानाम् sounds, सागराणाम् in the seas, पातालतलवासिनः inhabiting the subterranean region, सर्वे all, दानवाःDanavas, सहस्रशःthousands, पन्नगाश्च snakes, व्यथिताः distressed

40018898.author: Translation
40018898.content: By the agitation and sounds in the seas, all the Danavas and snakes in thousands inhabiting the seas got distressed.

40018899.author: पदार्थः
40018899.content: सशैलवनकानना with mountains, gardens, forests, कृत्स्ना dark, मेदिनी earth, चकम्पे shook, भास्करश्च even the sun, निष्प्रभः lost radiance, आसीत् not move, मारुतश्चापि even the wind, न ववौ not blow

40018899.author: Translation
40018899.content: The entire globe with its mountains, gardens and forests shook, the Sun lost his radiance, even the wind did not blow.

40018900.author: पदार्थः
40018900.content: ततः then, सगन्धर्वाः the Gandharvas, देवाःDevas, सिद्धाश्च Siddhas, परमर्षयः great sages, सकिन्नरमहोरगाः Kinneras, and huge serpents, सर्वे all, चिन्ताम् anxiety, अपेदिरे became

40018900.author: Translation
40018900.content: Thereafter, the Gandharvas, Devas, Siddhas, great sages, Kinneras and huge serpents all of them became anxious.

40018901.author: पदार्थः
40018901.content: तदा then, सर्षिगणाः hosts of sages, ते the, देवाः Devas, गोब्राह्मणेभ्यः  cows, brahmanas, स्वस्ति be auspicious, अस्तु be, लोकाः worlds, शाश्वताः ever, तिष्ठन्तु endure, राघवः Raghava, संख्ये large numbers, राक्षसेश्वरम् Rakshasa king, रावणम् Ravana, जयताम् conquer, एवम् in that way, जपन्तः chanted, घोरम् terrific, रोमहर्षणम् caused hair to stand, रामरावणयोः both Rama and Ravana, युद्धम् war, अपश्यन् witnessed

40018901.author: Translation
40018901.content: "May the hosts of sages, Devas, cows and brahmanas be auspicious. May all the worlds endure forever. May Rama conquer Ravana, the Rakshasa king," chanting in that manner all witnessed the terrific war between Rama and Ravana that caused hair to stand.

40018902.author: पदार्थः
40018902.content: तदा then, सर्षिगणाः hosts of sages, ते the, देवाः Devas, गोब्राह्मणेभ्यः  cows, brahmanas, स्वस्ति be auspicious, अस्तु be, लोकाः worlds, शाश्वताः ever, तिष्ठन्तु endure, राघवः Raghava, संख्ये large numbers, राक्षसेश्वरम् Rakshasa king, रावणम् Ravana, जयताम् conquer, एवम् in that way, जपन्तः chanted, घोरम् terrific, रोमहर्षणम् caused hair to stand, रामरावणयोः both Rama and Ravana, युद्धम् war, अपश्यन् witnessed

40018902.author: Translation
40018902.content: "May the hosts of sages, Devas, cows and brahmanas be auspicious. May all the worlds endure forever. May Rama conquer Ravana, the Rakshasa king," chanting in that manner all witnessed the terrific war between Rama and Ravana that caused hair to stand.

40018903.author: पदार्थः
40018903.content: गन्धर्वाप्सरसाम् Gandharvas and Apsaras, सङ्घाः combination, अनूपमम् unimaginable, युद्धम् war, दृष्टवा watching, गगनम् sky, गगनाकारम् sky is its own analogue, सागरःsea, गरोपमः sea is its own compeer, रामरावणयोः both Rama and Ravana, युद्धम् fight, रामरावणयोः likened Rama and Ravana's struggle, युद्धम् combat, रामरावणयोरिव both Rama and Ravana, एवम् in that manner, ब्रुवन्तः said, रामरावणम् Rama and Ravana, तत् that, युद्धम् war, ददृशुः looked

40018903.author: Translation
40018903.content: Gandharvas and Apsaras watching the combination of Rama and Ravana fighting an unimaginable war said that sky is its own analogue for sky, sea is its own analogue to sea, in the same way is the struggle between Rama and Ravana is unique like Rama and Ravana's struggle and looked at the combat.

40018904.author: पदार्थः
40018904.content: गन्धर्वाप्सरसाम् Gandharvas and Apsaras, सङ्घाः combination, अनूपमम् unimaginable, युद्धम् war, दृष्टवा watching, गगनम् sky, गगनाकारम् sky is its own analogue, सागरःsea, गरोपमः sea is its own compeer, रामरावणयोः both Rama and Ravana, युद्धम् fight, रामरावणयोः likened Rama and Ravana's struggle, युद्धम् combat, रामरावणयोरिव both Rama and Ravana, एवम् in that manner, ब्रुवन्तः said, रामरावणम् Rama and Ravana, तत् that, युद्धम् war, ददृशुः looked

40018904.author: Translation
40018904.content: Gandharvas and Apsaras watching the combination of Rama and Ravana fighting an unimaginable war said that sky is its own analogue for sky, sea is its own analogue to sea, in the same way is the struggle between Rama and Ravana is unique like Rama and Ravana's struggle and looked at the combat.

40018905.author: पदार्थः
40018905.content: ततः then, महाबहुः mighty armed, रघूणाम् Raghava, कीर्तिवर्धनः enhancer of glory, रामः Rama, क्रोधात् in wrath, धनुषा bow, आशिविषोपमम् like a venomous snake, शरम् arrows, सन्धाय fitting, श्रीम् graced, ज्वलितकुण्डलम् shining earrings, रावणस्यशिरः Ravana's head, अच्छिन्दत् cut off, तदा then, भूमौ on earth surface, पतितम् fallen, तत् that, शिरः head, त्रिभिः three, लोकैः in the world, दृष्टम् witnessed

40018905.author: Translation
40018905.content: Then the mighty armed Raghava, enhancer of glory, in wrath like a venomous snake, fitting the bow with arrows cut off the head of Ravana graced with shining earrings. Then the three worlds witnessed the head cut off and fallen on the earth surface.

40018906.author: पदार्थः
40018906.content: ततः then, महाबहुः mighty armed, रघूणाम् Raghava, कीर्तिवर्धनः enhancer of glory, रामः Rama, क्रोधात् in wrath, धनुषा bow, आशिविषोपमम् like a venomous snake, शरम् arrows, सन्धाय fitting, श्रीम् graced, ज्वलितकुण्डलम् shining earrings, रावणस्यशिरः Ravana's head, अच्छिन्दत् cut off, तदा then, भूमौ on earth surface, पतितम् fallen, तत् that, शिरः head, त्रिभिः three, लोकैः in the world, दृष्टम् witnessed

40018906.author: Translation
40018906.content: Then the mighty armed Raghava, enhancer of glory, in wrath like a venomous snake, fitting the bow with arrows cut off the head of Ravana graced with shining earrings. Then the three worlds witnessed the head cut off and fallen on the earth surface.

40018907.author: पदार्थः
40018907.content: तस्यैव similar, सदृशम् looking similar, अन्यत् another, रावणस्य Ravana's, शिरः head, उत्थितम् arose, तत् that, क्षिप्रहस्तेन cut off by hand, क्षिप्रकारिणा quick with hand, रामेण by Rama, क्षिप्तम् cut off

40018907.author: Translation
40018907.content: A similar looking head arose on Ravana's head. Rama, endowed with a quick hand, cut off by his hand the other head.

40018908.author: पदार्थः
40018908.content: सम्यति before that, द्वितीयम् second, रावणशिरः Ravana's head, सायकैः by arrows, छिन्नम् cut off, तत् that, शीर्षम् head, छिन्नमात्रम् as he cut, पुनरेव again, दृश्यते appeared

40018908.author: Translation
40018908.content: Before cutting that second head of Ravana again another head appeared.

40018909.author: पदार्थः
40018909.content: तदपि in that way, अशनिसङ्काशैः like thunderbolt of Indra, रामसायकैःRama's arrows, छिन्नम् cut off, एवमेव in that place, तुल्यवर्चसाम् equally charming, शिरसाम् head, शतम् hundred, छिन्नम् struck off

40018909.author: Translation
40018909.content: Rama cut off the afore said head with Indra's thunderbolt like arrows. In that way equally charming a hundred heads were struck off.

40018910.author: पदार्थः
40018910.content: रावणस्य Ravana's, जीवितक्षये life not ceased, अन्तः end, न चैवदृश्यते not able to see, ततः then, सर्वास्त्रवित् knower of all knowledge, वीरः valiant, कौसल्यानन्दवर्धनः enhancer of Kausalya's joy, बहुभिः many, मार्गणैः ways, युक्तः well versed, राघवःRaghava, चिन्तयामास started thinking

40018910.author: Translation
40018910.content: Rama, knower of all shastras, valiant, enhancer of Kausalya's joy, well versed in the use of weapons, was not able to see the end of Ravana's life. He started thinking.

40018911.author: पदार्थः
40018911.content: यैः by which, मारीचः Maricha, निहतः killed, यैः he, सदूषणः Dushana, खरः Khara, क्रौञ्चानने in Krauncha, कबन्धः Kabhanda, दण्डकानने in Dandaka forest, विराधःतु Virada also, यैः by which, सालाःSala, गिरयः mountain, भग्नाः broken, वाली च Vali also, अम्बुधिः ocean, क्षुभितः agitation, वाली च and Vali, अम्बुधिः ocean, क्षुभितः agitated, ते they, मेसायकाः by my arrows, सर्वे all, मम my, युद्धे war, प्रात्ययिकाः wasted, येन by which, रावणे Ravana, मन्दतेजसः less brilliant, तत् that, कारणम् reason, किंनु What is it

40018911.author: Translation
40018911.content: 'Earlier, by my arrows, Maricha was killed, Dushana and Khara were killed, Kabhanda was killed in Krauncha forest, Virada was killed in Dandaka forest. By which arrows Sala trees were cut off, mountain was broken, ocean was agitated, and Vali was killed, are wasted with Ravana, who is less brilliant in war. What is the reason?'

40018912.author: पदार्थः
40018912.content: यैः by which, मारीचः Maricha, निहतः killed, यैः he, सदूषणः Dushana, खरः Khara, क्रौञ्चानने in Krauncha, कबन्धः Kabhanda, दण्डकानने in Dandaka forest, विराधःतु Virada also, यैः by which, सालाःSala, गिरयः mountain, भग्नाः broken, वाली च Vali also, अम्बुधिः ocean, क्षुभितः agitation, वाली च and Vali, अम्बुधिः ocean, क्षुभितः agitated, ते they, मेसायकाः by my arrows, सर्वे all, मम my, युद्धे war, प्रात्ययिकाः wasted, येन by which, रावणे Ravana, मन्दतेजसः less brilliant, तत् that, कारणम् reason, किंनु What is it

40018912.author: Translation
40018912.content: 'Earlier, by my arrows, Maricha was killed, Dushana and Khara were killed, Kabhanda was killed in Krauncha forest, Virada was killed in Dandaka forest. By which arrows Sala trees were cut off, mountain was broken, ocean was agitated, and Vali was killed, are wasted with Ravana, who is less brilliant in war. What is the reason?'

40018913.author: पदार्थः
40018913.content: यैः by which, मारीचः Maricha, निहतः killed, यैः he, सदूषणः Dushana, खरः Khara, क्रौञ्चानने in Krauncha, कबन्धः Kabhanda, दण्डकानने in Dandaka forest, विराधःतु Virada also, यैः by which, सालाःSala, गिरयः mountain, भग्नाः broken, वाली च Vali also, अम्बुधिः ocean, क्षुभितः agitation, वाली च and Vali, अम्बुधिः ocean, क्षुभितः agitated, ते they, मेसायकाः by my arrows, सर्वे all, मम my, युद्धे war, प्रात्ययिकाः wasted, येन by which, रावणे Ravana, मन्दतेजसः less brilliant, तत् that, कारणम् reason, किंनु What is it

40018913.author: Translation
40018913.content: 'Earlier, by my arrows, Maricha was killed, Dushana and Khara were killed, Kabhanda was killed in Krauncha forest, Virada was killed in Dandaka forest. By which arrows Sala trees were cut off, mountain was broken, ocean was agitated, and Vali was killed, are wasted with Ravana, who is less brilliant in war. What is the reason?'

40018914.author: पदार्थः
40018914.content: राघवः Raghava, सम्युगे in that duel, इति thus, चिन्तापरः started thinking, अप्रमत्तश्च very alert, आसीत् not move, रावणोरसि Ravana's chest, शरवर्षाणि rain of arrows, ववर्ष rained

40018914.author: Translation
40018914.content: Even though Raghava was thinking so, yet remaining alert in the duel, rained arrows on Ravana's chest.

40018915.author: पदार्थः
40018915.content: वीरः valiant, राघवः Raghava, रिपोः enemy, स्यन्दने in chariot, विंशतिम् seated, त्रिंशतिम् three hundred, षष्टिम् sixties, अथ and, शतशः hundreds, सहस्रशः thousands, सायकान् arrows, मुमोच released

40018915.author: Translation
40018915.content: Valiant enemy of Raghava also seated in the chariot, rained three hundred, sixties, hundreds, and thousands of arrows.

40018916.author: पदार्थः
40018916.content: तुमुलम् fierce, रोमहर्षणम् horipulating, महत् great, तत् that, युद्धम् war, अन्तरिक्षे च even in the sky, भूमौ च also on earth, पुनश्च again, गिरिमूर्धनि on top of mountain, प्रवृत्तम् commenced again

40018916.author: Translation
40018916.content: Great war commenced in the sky, as well as on the earth, and on top of mountain again, which was horipulating,

40018917.author: पदार्थः
40018917.content: देवदानवयक्षाणाम् Devas, Danavas, Yakshas, पिशाचोरगरक्षसाम् demons, Nagas, and Rakshasas, पश्यताम् watched, तत् that, महायुद्धम् great war, सप्तरात्रम् seven nights and days, अवर्तत continued

40018917.author: Translation
40018917.content: The Devas, Danavas, Yakshasas also the fiends Demon, Nagas and Rakshasas watched the great war that continued for seven days and nights.

40018918.author: पदार्थः
40018918.content: रामरावणयोः Rama and Ravana, युद्धम् fight, रात्रिम् night, विरामम् ceased, न उपगच्छति started, दिवसम् all day, न not, मुहूर्तम् a moment, न not, क्षणं च not a second, न not

40018918.author: Translation
40018918.content: The fight between Rama and Ravana continued all day and night, without stopping for a moment.
